The values present in the CSV files contained in this folder have been extracted from Tables III to VI from the original paper [1].

[1] J. Xu, J. Yu, S. Hu, X. Liu, and H. Meng, “Mixed Precision Low-Bit Quantization of Neural Network Language Models for Speech Recognition,” IEEE/ACM Transactions on Audio, Speech, and Language Processing, vol. 29, pp. 3679–3693, 2021, doi: 10.1109/TASLP.2021.3129357.
